v10-47.candidate: They favoured Alexander, because he had been the first to speak peaceful words to them, and they fought alongside him continually.
v10-47.close: They favoured Alexander, because he had been the first to speak peaceful words to them, and they remained his allies all his days.

v10-89.candidate: He sent him a golden clasp, as is customarily given to the Kinsmen of kings, and gave him Ekron and all its territory as an inheritance.
v10-89.close: He sent him a golden clasp, as is customarily given to the king’s Kinsmen, and gave him Ekron and all its territory as an inheritance.
